_about: Steve edits this file. It says how the app treats culturally designated areas from BC's land-use plans and what it tells people about them. The pipeline matches entries by the area's LOCATION_NAME in BC's Legal Planning Objectives data. 'status' is one of: block (removed from the app, shown on the map as closed), flag (zones stay, with this note beside them), seasonal (zones stay, with closure dates). Only state what the Nations or the Province have published, credited with a link. Never add stories. Every entry with "review": true needs Steve's sign-off before going live.

rules._about: Steve's decision (2026-11-07): flag cultural areas with why they're cultural and who to contact; block them where they are documented as cultural use. Joffre Lakes / Pipi7íyekw is an exception: it closes only part of the year.

Pipi7iyekw Old Growth and Sensitive Area.title: Pipi7íyekw (Cerise Creek Old-Growth and Sensitive Area)
Pipi7iyekw Old Growth and Sensitive Area.why: Líl̓wat Nation. A 2019 provincial order protects the cultural heritage resources here for First Nations' food, social and ceremonial use. Next door, Pipi7íyekw / Joffre Lakes Park closes on set dates so the Líl̓wat Nation and N'Quatqua can use the land for cultural practices: June 20–27 and September 8–30 in 2026. Check BC Parks for current dates before you go.

Callaghan.why: A First Nations' Cultural Management Area in the Sea to Sky land-use plan: an area with high First Nations cultural values, where use and development are meant to protect those values. Recreation isn't banned. The Callaghan sits in territory of both the Líl̓wat and Squamish Nations.

watch: A new Squamish Nation land use objectives order (2026 draft: 33 Síiyamin sites and 6 Special Cultural Management Areas) would stop use of existing public trails inside those areas. Public comment closed July 20, 2026. When it is finalised, its areas should probably be blocked; check whether BC's data includes them and update this file.
